Kurnool recorded the highest births among the listed districts
Births rose from 7,14,017 in 2020 to 7,37,189 in 2021

o: Colombia – Aligning with the required transition

o: Jobs added during the period – about 40 million

o: It is released by the World Meteorological Organization
Sea-level rise on the Pacific and Indian Ocean sides was below the global average
Warming in 1991–2024 was almost double that of 1961–1990
2024 was the highest-temperature year globally since 1850
ca8e272635afdf.x: Sea-level rise on the Pacific and Indian Ocean sides was above the global average, not below.

ca098801328cba.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Critical and Emerging Technologies Index?
o: Artificial intelligence carries a weight of 20%
It covers 25 countries and five sectors
India is weak in semiconductors despite the Semicon India Programme
ca098801328cba.x: Artificial intelligence carries a weight of 25%, not 20%.

cae65c9a9f7bdd.x: India has seven natural World Heritage sites, not six.

Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, University of Washington
Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago

cae588758b655e.x: Andhra Pradesh spent ₹2.6 lakh per inmate a year, the highest among States.

ca88704b65f640.s: What was the national score in the National Annual Report and Index on Women's Safety (NARI) 2025?
ca88704b65f640.x: NARI 2025 recorded a national score of 65%, with six in ten women feeling safe.

ca3dc9b58a172a.s: Andhra Pradesh's biomass power potential is:
ca3dc9b58a172a.x: Biomass potential is 1,999 MW; 280 MW is the bagasse-cogeneration potential and 2,596 MW the large-hydro potential.

caf7d3e9502e2a.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in the India Justice Report 2019?
caf7d3e9502e2a.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked 13th in 2019 and 12th in 2020.

ca939a9b1ef5cf.s: What was India's rank in the Sustainable Development Report 2022?
ca939a9b1ef5cf.x: India ranked 121st in 2022, after 120th in 2021; it ranked 112th in 2023.

ca375ea85619de.x: NARI 2025 was published by the Group of Intellectuals and Academicians; it is not an NCRB publication.

ca2ea47f335177.s: Which State ranked first as the most heat-risk-prone in the CEEW district-level heat-risk study?

o: Bureau of Energy Efficiency with the Alliance for an Energy Efficient Economy
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy with IEA
caaf48882b0655.x: The SEEI 2024 was prepared by BEE with AEEE; it classified Andhra Pradesh as an 'Achiever'.

cacff59cfdc545.s: According to the Production Gap Report 2025, coal should approach phase-out by:

ca1ea64dfa1adf.x: India ranked 130th of 193 countries in the HDI 2025.

ca9b5b7f7334dc.x: It recommended district-level plans, along with reskilling, dedicated transition funds and social dialogue.

ca8292925eedec.x: India recorded 1.72 million deaths annually; 2.5 million was the global figure.

ca232ae6681347.s: The Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) has been published since:
ca232ae6681347.x: The CCPI, by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and Climate Action Network, has been published since 2005.

caa8be2e0f9df3.s: As per the SRS Statistical Report 2023, India's Total Fertility Rate in 2023 was:
caa8be2e0f9df3.x: India's TFR was 1.9 in 2023, below the replacement level of 2.1.

ca9784c039707a.s: Andhra Pradesh's total renewable-energy potential is:
ca9784c039707a.x: The total potential is 1,67,060 MW; 1,23,336 MW is the wind potential alone.

caaaae9d9a303b.s: Who was the Registrar General of India for the Civil Registration System report on Andhra Pradesh (2021)?
caaaae9d9a303b.x: Mritunjay Kumar Narayan was the Registrar General of India.

cad7adca502c14.s: As per the Civil Registration System report, deaths in Andhra Pradesh in 2021 rose over 2020 by:
cad7adca502c14.x: Deaths rose from 4,55,000 to 5,56,102, an increase of 22.2%, attributed to the COVID-19 second wave.

ca5a63836d2712.s: The Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2026 covers the European Union and how many countries?
ca5a63836d2712.x: It covers 63 countries and the EU, together accounting for 90% of global greenhouse-gas emissions.

ca456aed9ea6f7.x: GRAP applies to the Delhi NCR region, while NCAP is a national programme.

caab836bc0cabd.s: The Sustainable Development Report 2025 was led by:
caab836bc0cabd.x: The SDR 2025 is by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network; its index uses 100 for full achievement of all 17 SDGs.

cac62c5a677dec.s: As per the Air Quality Life Index, Delhi would gain about ____ of life expectancy if the WHO PM2.5 limit were met.
cac62c5a677dec.x: Delhi's largest potential gain was 8.2 years; 9.4 months was the gain for India's cleanest regions.

ca5c2b7e160e24.s: Which country was identified as the most polluted in the Air Quality Life Index 2025?
ca5c2b7e160e24.x: Bangladesh was the most polluted country, with PM2.5 at 12 times the WHO limit.

ca5b13ae291c84.s: Planned 2030 fossil-fuel output is projected to exceed the 1.5°C-consistent level by over:
ca5b13ae291c84.x: Overall planned output exceeds the 1.5°C level by over 120%; 500% is the coal-specific figure.

o: It is the highest peacetime gallantry award
Both civilians and military personnel are eligible
It is presented by the President
ca3660f6824a6d.x: The Kirti Chakra is the second-highest, not the highest, peacetime gallantry award.

cad33e22e09702.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched in the life of Vithalbhai Patel?
o: Entry into the Bombay Legislative Council – 1912
Motilal Nehru's motion for a separate Assembly Department – 1928
Entry into the Imperial Legislative Council – 1912

cada14b99143ed.s: Which of the following works of László Krasznahorkai is wrongly matched with its year of publication?
cada14b99143ed.x: Seiobo There Below was published in 2008, not 2004.

Arrange the following events in the life of Batukeshwar Dutt in chronological order:
1. Re-arrested during the Quit India Movement
2. Released from jail
3. In Salem Jail when Bhagat Singh, Rajguru and Sukhdev were hanged

caea012db41a63.s: Shimon Sakaguchi, 2025 Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine, is known for his discovery concerning:
caea012db41a63.x: Sakaguchi's discovery concerned regulatory T cells, the CD4⁺CD25⁺ subset in mice.

ca62833c671f57.x: K. Rajashekar Reddy was his coach; Nara Lokesh and Brahmani are his parents.

ca17a4afc6d701.x: Bezalel Smotrich signed the India–Israel Bilateral Investment Treaty.

ca14783c452433.x: MOFs combine metal ions with organic ligands; unlike rigid zeolites, some MOFs can 'breathe'.

cae1a2c8d1e484.s: The Padma awards, instituted in 1954, are announced every year on:
cae1a2c8d1e484.x: The Padma awards are announced on the eve of Republic Day, 25 January, not 26 January.

ca9ba0dd657f0d.x: APSDRF secured the third prize among eight teams in the competition held in Ghaziabad.

cad995225335cc.x: Safeena Husain founded Educate Girls in 2007; its volunteers are called Team Balika.

ca96f4af49ffee.x: He killed five terrorists on the LoC in Kupwara with zero Indian casualties.

cabf4a007291fc.s: Besides a gold medal and a diploma, the 2025 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences carries a monetary award of:
cabf4a007291fc.x: The prize consists of a gold medal, a diploma and $1.2 million.

ca3da116c270ea.s: In which year did Jayaprakash Narayan receive the Ramon Magsaysay Award?

caa41d2cbe778c.x: Aghion and Howitt co-developed the model in 1992; it underlies the theory recognised by the 2025 Economics Nobel.

cae1332973799f.x: He was the Collector of Anantapur, where all villages were declared ODF Plus model villages.

ned4cb948092.x: 'Procedure Established by Law' was borrowed from Japan, not the USA.

ca3071d75a4cf2.s: Who wrote 'The Economic History of India', which shaped the understanding of deindustrialisation?

nacbcba9173a.x: Fundamental Duties were borrowed from the USSR.

cae3ccdc04ca09.x: The Drafting Committee was constituted on 29 August 1947; the Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949.

cadf68c547e8cf.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded 62.1%, ahead of Karnataka (61.7%), Telangana (61.5%) and Tamil Nadu (58.8%).

ca869c2e778a1b.x: Orange means Be Prepared at 41–44°C; Red means Extreme Danger at 45°C and above.

caaee841463b76.x: The stipend is ₹1,500 per month, with ₹1,000 for books, through 26 BC Study Circles.

caecf2c3792f85.s: In AY 2024-25, the national average share of ITR-1 filers with income above ₹5 lakh was:
caecf2c3792f85.x: The national average was 55.3%; Andhra Pradesh's 62.1% was the highest among major States.

ca64c84d3c7b13.x: The 56th GST Council proposed reducing the slabs from 4 to 2.

It provided for district nodal officers and 24x7 control rooms
India–Pakistan tensions were cited as its reason
cab2a14fc2538d.x: CBRN preparedness was included among the measures, not excluded.

Implementing institution – Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

In the WHO South-East Asia Region, 24 million pregnant women had hepatitis B

CDSCO reports through DGHS to the Health Ministry

EPS pension eligibility requires 5 years of pensionable service

The strategy had earlier been used in Mizoram during the 1960s
Strategic hamleting was borrowed from the US war strategy in Vietnam

cac3f4fa78aaeb.x: The female LFPR target is 35% by 2030, not 2035.

ca1aa1bf3c0a98.x: 2022 enrolment was 12 lakh against 25 lakh seats in over 14,000 ITIs.

cac112a3fdb896.s: What share of PMJAY spending goes to private hospitals?
cac112a3fdb896.x: Private hospitals receive two-thirds of PMJAY spending, not one-third.

ca618a23443010.s: The Harmonized Accessibility Guidelines were issued in:
ca618a23443010.x: The Harmonized Accessibility Guidelines were issued in 2021; the Mental Health Care Act dates from 2017.

ca80ea8bb46b94.s: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, which Andhra Pradesh district reported the lowest tap-water coverage (35.55%)?
ca80ea8bb46b94.x: Palnadu had the lowest coverage at 35.55%, while YSR district reported 100%.

ca335892c75ec1.s: In the stroke-awareness campaign 'FAST', the letter 'A' stands for:
ca335892c75ec1.x: FAST stands for Face, Arms, Speech and Time.

ca712b4e5a046e.s: Census 2011 recorded disability prevalence in India at:
ca712b4e5a046e.x: Census 2011 recorded 26.8 million persons with disabilities, or 2.21%.

cada8ecc090ab2.s: During 2014–2021, India's under-five mortality rate declined from 45 to ____ per 1,000.
cada8ecc090ab2.x: The under-five mortality rate fell from 45 to 31 per 1,000 during 2014–2021.

ca0277357c1531.s: Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act reserves what share of Class 1 seats in private unaided schools for disadvantaged and EWS children?

ca3331adf953c5.s: India, the largest groundwater user, accounts for about what share of global groundwater extraction?
ca3331adf953c5.x: India is the largest groundwater user, with about 25% of global extraction.

ca4d96a622f13a.s: The National Education Policy, 2020 provides for vocational exposure from:
ca4d96a622f13a.x: NEP 2020 provides vocational exposure from Grade 6.

ca602fac229244.s: The Gutti Koya tribals were displaced by anti-Maoist operations from which State?
ca602fac229244.x: They were displaced from Chhattisgarh, where they are recognised as Scheduled Tribes, unlike in AP and Telangana.

cafe0bd5be1604.s: ULLAS treats full literacy as at least what share of literacy among people aged 15 years and above?
cafe0bd5be1604.x: ULLAS uses a 95% benchmark for those aged 15 and above, including digital and financial literacy.

ca94a89144ac7b.s: Branded drugs may be stocked in Jan Aushadhi stores:
o: Only with prior approval, when no generic alternative exists
Without prior approval, even when a generic exists
With prior approval, even when a generic exists
Without prior approval, when no generic exists
ca94a89144ac7b.x: Branded drugs need prior approval and are allowed only when no generic alternative exists.

cac1a93e7c99cc.s: Under the proposed EPFO withdrawal norms, what minimum balance must be kept in the EPF account?
cac1a93e7c99cc.x: The proposed minimum balance is 25%; education withdrawals are allowed up to 10 times and marriage withdrawals up to 5 times.

ca9840ff61579a.s: Under the CBSE two-examination system, which score is counted?
ca9840ff61579a.x: The better of the two scores counts; Essential Repeat students cannot take the second examination.

ca2266b724e5bb.s: The Washington Group–Short Set, suggested for disability data, can be aligned with how many categories under the RPwD Act, 2016?
ca2266b724e5bb.x: It can be aligned with the 21 disability categories recognised under the RPwD Act, 2016.

caf78c8a62d4a5.s: Which country did WHO validate as the first to eliminate mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B?
caf78c8a62d4a5.x: WHO validated Maldives as the first country to achieve this triple elimination.

ca276b367ca2c9.s: India's Universal Immunisation Programme covers how many infants every year?
ca276b367ca2c9.x: UIP covers 2.6 crore infants and 2.9 crore pregnant women each year, making it the world's largest.

ca56816d659065.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the India–Pakistan religious-visit framework?
o: The Simla Agreement of 1972 has a non-binding exchanges clause
The 1974 Protocol covers Nankana Sahib and Ajmer Sharif
Nankana Sahib, in Pakistan's Punjab, is the birthplace of Guru Nanak
ca56816d659065.x: Katas Raj is in Punjab; it is Shadani Darbar that is in Sindh.

cacd5eb34a1e32.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the New Strategic EU–India Agenda?
o: It has five priorities including trade, technology and connectivity
Multilateral engagement is one of its priorities
Defence and security is one of its priorities
The EU is India's second-largest trading partner
cacd5eb34a1e32.x: The EU is India's largest trading partner, not the second-largest.

ca5462b3891e2d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Doha ceasefire of 19 October 2025?
o: Follow-up talks were scheduled in Kabul
Afghanistan announced a boycott of the cricket series
Pakistani airstrikes in Paktika targeted the Hafiz Gul Bahadur group
The threat groups identified included IS-K and al-Qaida affiliates
ca5462b3891e2d.x: Follow-up talks were to take place in Doha, not Kabul.

ca41d2746fde1c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Amir Khan Muttaqi's visit to India and India's engagement with Afghanistan?
o: Muttaqi assured India that Afghan soil would not be used against it
Both sides shared concern about Daesh (ISIS)
The Zaranj–Delaram Highway is an Indian project in Afghanistan
The Salma Dam and the Zaranj–Delaram Highway are the same project
ca41d2746fde1c.x: The Salma Dam and the Zaranj–Delaram Highway are separate Indian projects in Afghanistan.

ca33fa4a5e3e0b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about recent democratic crises in South Asia?
o: Sri Lanka's 2022 Aragalaya was directed against Gotabaya Rajapaksa
Bangladesh's 2024 July Uprising was directed against Sheikh Hasina
Nepal's 2025 Gen Z protest against K.P. Sharma Oli followed a social media ban
ca33fa4a5e3e0b.x: The Bangladesh July Uprising lasted 21 days, not 30.

ca94ecc2d232d5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the JCPOA and Iran's nuclear programme?
o: The United States withdrew from the JCPOA in 2019
Germany was a party to the JCPOA
Israel–US strikes hit Iranian nuclear sites in June 2025
ca94ecc2d232d5.x: The United States withdrew from the JCPOA in 2018, not 2019.

caa60fe8eaa54c.s: With reference to the US pharmaceutical tariff announcement, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Tariff cap for the EU and Japan – 15%
EU and Japan's share of US pharmaceutical imports – 30%
Generics' share of US pharmaceutical spending – 90%
caa60fe8eaa54c.x: The EU and Japan were capped at 15%; they supply about 75% of US pharma imports, and generics make up 90% of prescriptions but 13% of spending.

ca5745bb832fb9.s: With reference to the Iran–Israel conflict of June 2025, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: 'Complete and Total Ceasefire' – Announced by Israel
Al-Udeid Air Base struck by Iran – Qatar
Al-Udeid Air Base struck by Iran – UAE
ca5745bb832fb9.x: Iran struck the US Al-Udeid Air Base in Qatar with advance notice; the ceasefire was announced by Trump and Israel's campaign lasted 11 days.

cabafaa21735de.s: Which country is not an NPT signatory and has no IAEA inspections of its undeclared nuclear arsenal?
cabafaa21735de.x: Israel is not an NPT signatory and has no IAEA inspections; Iran was only debating an NPT-exit bill in June 2025.

cab9b358e595d9.s: Along with an Agreement on Information Sharing, which pact was signed at the inaugural Australia–India Defence Ministers' Dialogue?
o: MoU on Submarine Search and Rescue Cooperation
cab9b358e595d9.x: The Dialogue produced an Agreement on Information Sharing and a separate MoU on Submarine Search and Rescue Cooperation.

n9dd674d805c.s: Under Operation Sindoor (6-7 May 2025), how many terror camps in Pakistan and PoK did India strike?
n9dd674d805c.x: Operation Sindoor struck nine terror camps after the Pahalgam attack of 22 April 2025.

cab5997c60b73f.s: US tariffs on some Indian exports in 2025 stood at:
cab5997c60b73f.x: The US tariffs on some Indian exports were 50%, not 40%.

n623d63c58e0.s: At the 3rd India–EU Trade and Technology Council meeting, a pilot was proposed to link the EU Digital Identity Wallet with:
n623d63c58e0.x: The pilot links DigiLocker, not Aadhaar, with the EU Digital Identity Wallet.

n3efdf6f8c9c.s: The European Union is India's ____ FTA partner.
n3efdf6f8c9c.x: The EU is India's 22nd FTA partner.

cab7628e9efce1.s: India and Japan have had a 'Special Strategic and Global Partnership' since:
cab7628e9efce1.x: The Special Strategic and Global Partnership dates from 2014.

ca5b1d2893cede.s: The third edition of the India–Australia exercise AUSTRAHIND (November 2024) was held in:
ca5b1d2893cede.x: AUSTRAHIND's third edition was held in Maharashtra, not Gujarat.

ca724005997a43.s: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of the Quad?
ca724005997a43.x: The Quad comprises India, Japan, Australia and the United States; China is not a member.

cab5dd2910218b.s: What is the total cost of the two India–Bhutan cross-border railway projects (Kokrajhar–Gelephu and Banarhat–Samtse)?
cab5dd2910218b.x: The two projects together cost ₹4,033 crore; the Kokrajhar–Gelephu line is 69 km long with six stations.

ca8ffb7eacfef0.s: At the Aravalli Summit at JNU, S. Jaishankar cited which treaty as a precedent from the Bangladesh Liberation War?
o: Indo-Soviet Treaty of Peace, Friendship and Cooperation
ca8ffb7eacfef0.x: He cited the 1971 Indo-Soviet Treaty, while stressing strategic autonomy and multi-alignment over bloc alignment.

ca5da461b7dc9d.s: Which UNCLOS Article calls for cooperation in semi-enclosed seas such as the Palk Bay and Gulf of Mannar?
ca5da461b7dc9d.x: UNCLOS Article 123 provides for cooperation among States bordering semi-enclosed seas.

cae67e1ff9fd84.s: The language of the US executive order 'Assuring the Security of the State of Qatar' mirrored:
cae67e1ff9fd84.x: The order's language mirrored NATO Article 5; it was part of Trump's 20-point Gaza plan.

cafb216e507965.s: Operation Sindoor was India's response to the terror attack on tourists at:
cafb216e507965.x: Operation Sindoor followed the Pahalgam terror attack and involved overt military action against Pakistan-based terror infrastructure.

caa40b6474872a.s: Nepal's constitutional map places Kalapani, Limpiyadhura and Lipulekh to the ____ of the Mahakali River.
caa40b6474872a.x: Nepal's map places the three areas east of the Mahakali River.

ca5014e5e450b8.s: TVS Motor announced an investment of how much in Solihull, UK, for Norton Motorcycles?
ca5014e5e450b8.x: TVS Motor's Solihull investment was £250 million, not £100 million.

ca2c367e81eb81.s: Japan pledged to invest how much in India over the next decade?
ca2c367e81eb81.x: Japan pledged ¥10 trillion over the next decade, in areas including infrastructure, manufacturing and clean energy.

ca3fc5f97b7efd.s: Which was the first OECD member with which India signed a Bilateral Investment Treaty under its new investment treaty framework?
ca3fc5f97b7efd.x: Israel was the first OECD member to sign a BIT with India under the new framework; the treaty has no tariff provisions.

ca777cecb98e60.s: Imperial College London partnered with which institution for its India engagement?
ca777cecb98e60.x: Imperial College London partnered with Science Gallery Bengaluru; Surrey and Lancaster were approved to open campuses in India.

cad4f52d1b5502.s: Under the US pharmaceutical tariff measure, the inclusion of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) was:
cad4f52d1b5502.x: The inclusion of APIs remained uncertain; PhRMA objected to the measure.

caa7a1c27a668c.s: India and Japan agreed to revise the Joint Declaration on Security Cooperation of:
caa7a1c27a668c.x: They agreed to revise the 2008 Joint Declaration on Security Cooperation.

cacd1d3cd0cd22.s: The London rallies cited as a sign of polarisation in Western democracies were led by:
cacd1d3cd0cd22.x: The London rallies were led by Tommy Robinson; Charlie Kirk was mentioned in connection with his murder in Utah.

caa460aabce397.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PM-KUSUM?
o: By September 2025, standalone solar pumps had reached about 25%
It includes solarisation of 35 lakh grid-connected pumps
By September 2025, decentralised solar plants had reached about 6%
caa460aabce397.x: Standalone solar pumps had reached about 70% by September 2025, not 16–25%.

ca0e4b9fc330c6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about developments concerning Pakistan and India in 2025?
o: India's Operation Sindoor followed the Pahalgam attack of 22 April 2025
Pakistan announced ₹14 crore compensation to families of terrorists
The IMF gave Pakistan a $1 billion loan under a $7 billion facility
Pakistan was added to the FATF grey list in October 2022
ca0e4b9fc330c6.x: Pakistan was removed from, not added to, the FATF grey list in October 2022.

cabc319740bee6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the India–South Africa 9th Joint Defence Committee meeting?
o: Defence Policy & Military Cooperation was one of the sub-committees
Defence Acquisition, Production, R&D was one of the sub-committees
The Defence Acquisition, Production, R&D sub-committee was replaced by the Defence Policy & Military Cooperation sub-committee
India and South Africa share membership of BRICS, IORA, IBSA and NAM
cabc319740bee6.x: The two sub-committees were separate; neither replaced the other.

ca3abcb9dfb7b1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's position at the SCO Summit 2025 (Tianjin Declaration)?
o: India endorsed the Belt and Road Initiative
India did not endorse CPEC through PoK
Modi described the Ukraine issue as 'it is humanity's call'
India refused to endorse the Belt and Road Initiative
ca3abcb9dfb7b1.x: India refused to endorse the BRI, including CPEC through PoK.

cadda8db2375dc.s: Which Mauritius Prime Minister attended the Ganga Aarti and visited Kashi Vishwanath Dham during the Varanasi engagement?
cadda8db2375dc.x: Prime Minister Navinchandra Ramgoolam attended the Ganga Aarti and visited Kashi Vishwanath Dham.

caebf358720cd1.s: Which country was admitted as an 'SCO Partner' at the SCO Summit 2025, taking the total to 10 members and 17 partners?
caebf358720cd1.x: Laos was admitted as a partner after observer and dialogue partner categories were merged into 'SCO Partner'.

ca1173959d3dbe.s: The 80th session of the UN General Assembly was held in:
ca1173959d3dbe.x: The UN was founded in 1945 and its 80th General Assembly session was in 2025.

cad81cd6fcfff6.s: Decisions of the UN Security Council 1267 Committee are taken by:
o: Vote of the five permanent members
cad81cd6fcfff6.x: The 1267 Committee, comprising all 15 UNSC members, decides by consensus, not majority vote.

cae95e7afe11fc.s: Trump announced a 100% tariff on all Chinese goods with effect from:
cae95e7afe11fc.x: The 100% tariff was announced from 1 November 2025, after China's 9 October export controls.

cacfc5138ab74e.s: Which historian used the term 'Axis of Upheaval' in 2009 for unstable states?
cacfc5138ab74e.x: Niall Ferguson used it in 2009; Kendall-Taylor and Fontaine popularised it in Foreign Affairs in April 2024.

ca3d75947c6d74.s: Australia's 2035 emissions-reduction target is ____ below 2005 levels.
ca3d75947c6d74.x: Australia's 2035 target is a 62–70% cut below 2005 levels, with net zero by 2050.

ca707abb4f7825.s: The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD), Africa's largest hydroelectric project, is on which river?
ca707abb4f7825.x: GERD lies on the Blue Nile near the Sudan border, with a storage capacity of 74 billion cubic metres.

ca3f07f4f7f538.s: In which year did Indonesia invade Timor-Leste?
ca3f07f4f7f538.x: Indonesia invaded Timor-Leste in 1975; the New York Agreements followed in 1999.

ca500c51e77e54.s: Madagascar, whose capital is Antananarivo, belongs to which regional bloc?
ca500c51e77e54.x: Madagascar's regional bloc is SADC; the African Union was likely to suspend it.

caa0a205b42ade.s: Which attack in Jammu and Kashmir did the SCO Summit 2025 Tianjin Declaration condemn?
caa0a205b42ade.x: The declaration condemned the 22 April Pahalgam attack, along with the Jaffer Express and Khuzdar attacks in Pakistan.

ca43145e200d35.s: Which two ASEAN members expressed reservations about Timor-Leste's membership?
ca43145e200d35.x: Singapore and Myanmar expressed reservations about Timor-Leste's membership.

ca45df4b563366.s: At the August 2025 summit on Ukraine, Europe planned a European-led:
ca45df4b563366.x: Europe planned a European-led 'reassurance force' and sought US security guarantees; NATO membership was ruled out.

caafab060493d3.s: The term 'G-2' for the US–China relationship first originated from:
caafab060493d3.x: The term first came from Obama–Hu Jintao in 2009; Trump did not coin it at Busan.

ca35ffce3a13fc.s: In which year did the UN General Assembly adopt a Panchsheel-based resolution?
ca35ffce3a13fc.x: The UNGA adopted a Panchsheel-based resolution in 1957; the 1961 Belgrade NAM Conference treated Panchsheel as NAM's core.

caeca3415b60ad.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sawalkote project and other Chenab developments?
o: Momentum for Sawalkote rose after India suspended the Indus Waters Treaty following the Pahalgam attack
Dulhasti and Baglihar are other Chenab projects
The Wullar Barrage was unrelated to this renewed momentum
caeca3415b60ad.x: The Wullar Barrage was also associated with the renewed momentum after the treaty's suspension.

cafb20465ac924.s: Which of the following pairs relating to European recognition of Palestine is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Spain, Ireland and Norway – Recognised Palestine
South Africa – Filed the genocide case against Israel at the ICJ
72% of Europeans – Backed upholding international law
cafb20465ac924.x: Germany and Austria were reluctant to recognise Palestine because of their Holocaust legacy.

cacd305de22f5b.s: Which Gaza site, built in 1985, hosted the Arafat–Clinton talks?
cacd305de22f5b.x: The Rashad Al-Shawa Cultural Center was built in 1985 and hosted Arafat–Clinton talks; Hamam al-Sammara is Gaza's only surviving Turkish bath.

ca975a648271d5.s: Around the UN's 80th anniversary, who argued that multilateralism is 'wounded, not dead'?
ca975a648271d5.x: Shashi Tharoor described multilateralism as 'wounded, not dead'.

ca21868730900b.s: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, which withdrew from the ICC, together formed:
ca21868730900b.x: The three military-led countries formed the Alliance of Sahel States and called the ICC a 'neo-colonial instrument'.

ca4f987912fe59.s: In which year did the PLO declare Palestinian statehood?
ca4f987912fe59.x: The PLO declared statehood in 1988; 147 of 193 UN members recognise Palestine.

cafdf507d7337d.s: Under the 2015 India–Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement, the enclave exchange day is observed on:
cafdf507d7337d.x: The exchange day was 31 July; 111 Indian enclaves went to Bangladesh and 51 Bangladeshi enclaves to India.

ca63fda19d042f.s: India ratified the Convention on Supplementary Compensation for Nuclear Damage in:
ca63fda19d042f.x: India signed the CSC in 2010 and ratified it in 2016; the India–US civil nuclear deal dates to 2008.

cabee19267d76a.s: Corn imports into India beyond the tariff-rate quota attract a duty of:
cabee19267d76a.x: Imports beyond the quota attract 50% duty, not 25%.

ca190504674906.s: A UNESCO assessment in August 2025 recorded damage to how many cultural sites in Gaza?
ca190504674906.x: UNESCO recorded damage to 110 cultural sites in Gaza.

ca72ecf1b39a3e.s: The 1.8 GW Sawalkote hydroelectric project on the Chenab is being developed by:
ca72ecf1b39a3e.x: Sawalkote is a 1.8 GW NHPC project on the Chenab in Jammu and Kashmir.

ca6bb270cf33ef.s: The Bureij Mosaic, found in Gaza in 2022, belongs to which period?
ca6bb270cf33ef.x: The Bureij Mosaic is Byzantine, not Roman; it was found in 2022 and covers 500 sq m.

ca136eed9ab124.s: Which group has governed Gaza since 2007?
ca136eed9ab124.x: Hamas, not the Palestinian Authority, has run Gaza since 2007.

ca5d2b6d26050b.s: In which year did Nepal run its rubella vaccine campaign for children aged 9 months–15 years?
ca5d2b6d26050b.x: The campaign was in 2012; the second routine dose came in 2016 and over 95% coverage was recorded in early 2024.

cadf2626f0142c.s: Withdrawal from the Rome Statute of the ICC becomes effective how long after notice to the UN Secretary-General?
cadf2626f0142c.x: Withdrawal takes effect one year after notice to the UN Secretary-General.

ca912e69425028.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Red Cross Society?
o: The Union Health Minister is its President
The President of India is its President
It was set up under Act XV of 1920
ca912e69425028.x: The Union Health Minister is its Chairman; the President of India is its President.

ca60654209e26c.s: Carlo Acutis, the Catholic Church's first millennial saint, was canonised at:
ca60654209e26c.x: He was canonised at St. Peter's Square, Vatican, not Westminster Hall.

ca2a18146ec4cb.s: Chadalawada Naga Rani's AP State Red Cross Award nomination recognised her relief work during the floods of which river?
ca2a18146ec4cb.x: The nomination recognised flood relief during the Budameru river floods; it was announced by A.K. Parida of IRCS AP.

ca7f8cfebfe02a.s: Which of the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh weightlifters and achievements is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Karnam Malleswari – Bronze in 69 kg, Sydney 2000
Ragala Venkat Rahul – Gold in 85 kg, Commonwealth Games 2018
Santoshi Matsa – Gold in 85 kg, Commonwealth Games 2018
E. Kamineni Eswara Rao – Arjuna Award
ca7f8cfebfe02a.x: Santoshi Matsa won silver at the 2014 Commonwealth Games; the 2018 85 kg gold was won by Ragala Venkat Rahul.

cab29259c70f07.s: Where were the Senior Nationals of April 2024, in which Done Murali Krishna won 1 gold and 2 silvers, held?
cab29259c70f07.x: The April 2024 Senior Nationals were held in Hyderabad; Istanbul hosted the 2022 junior event.

ca7697b0886c88.s: Powerlifter Done Murali Krishna has won how many medals, including 18 gold?
ca7697b0886c88.x: His tally is 40 medals, including 18 gold.

ca8baaabbabf86.s: Who is the mentor of the planned Wrestling Academy in Andhra Pradesh?
ca8baaabbabf86.x: Madireddi Kesava Rao is the mentor; R.K. Purushotham is APAWA president and Sanjay Singh is WFI president.

caccad5555949d.s: How many matches were played in the 12th State-Level Inter-District Women's Kabaddi tournament?
caccad5555949d.x: The tournament had 48 matches, with players from 13 erstwhile districts.

caac8665450fcb.s: Arigela Bhargav Ram and Gobburu Viswa Tej were ranked World No. 1 by BWF in which category?
caac8665450fcb.x: The pair, together since the 2018 National Championship, reached World No. 1 in BWF junior boys doubles.

ca4e8495b5bd0f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27?
o: The third Kartavya is based on Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas
Non-debt receipts in RE 2025–26 were ₹34 lakh crore
The second Kartavya seeks to make people partners in prosperity
Non-debt receipts in BE 2026–27 were estimated at ₹34 lakh crore
ca4e8495b5bd0f.x: Non-debt receipts in BE 2026–27 were ₹36.5 lakh crore; ₹34 lakh crore was the RE 2025–26 figure.

ca49378d96499f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NITI Aayog Fiscal Health Index 2023-24?
o: It was released on 11 March 2026 as the second edition
Tax Sustainability is one of its sub-indices
Debt Sustainability is one of its sub-indices
ca49378d96499f.x: The fifth sub-index is Debt Sustainability, not Tax Sustainability.

nbc567b4321c.s: Andhra Pradesh's fiscal deficit ratio for 2026-27 is estimated at:
nbc567b4321c.x: The fiscal deficit ratio fell from about 4.6% to 3.84%, still above the 3% norm.

ca037342481aa0.s: What allocation did the Polavaram Project receive in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
ca037342481aa0.x: Polavaram got ₹6,105 crore; Amaravati got ₹6,000 crore and major irrigation ₹9,906 crore.

ca6cfe59722391.s: Which scheme was the largest welfare expenditure in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
ca6cfe59722391.x: NTR Bharosa, with ₹27,719 crore, was the largest welfare expenditure.

n956ff9ead67.s: Capital expenditure of about ₹48,697 crore in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 was an increase over the previous year of:
n956ff9ead67.x: Capital expenditure of ₹48,697 crore represented a 47% rise over the previous year.

caebd81198b0d4.s: Net tax receipts of the Centre in BE 2026–27 are estimated at:
caebd81198b0d4.x: BE 2026–27 net tax receipts are ₹28.7 lakh crore; ₹26.7 lakh crore was the RE 2025–26 figure.

ca00bfc2986271.s: Who is the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog?
ca00bfc2986271.x: Suman Bery is the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog, set up in 2015.

ca6e5453f1709b.s: In the NITI Aayog Fiscal Health Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh's weakest sub-index (score 4.2) was:
ca6e5453f1709b.x: AP scored lowest in Debt Sustainability (4.2) and highest in Quality of Expenditure (43.1).

ca4652cf08b0bd.s: If the Budget is described as the remedy, the Economic Survey functions as the:
ca4652cf08b0bd.x: The Economic Survey functions as a diagnosis, whereas the Budget functions as a remedy.

ca857ac25c79f5.s: Which app supports emergency response for women's safety under the Andhra Pradesh Budget?
ca857ac25c79f5.x: Women's safety is supported through the Shakti App emergency response.

ca689757f6dd90.s: Who presented the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
ca689757f6dd90.x: Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav presented the budget, which focused on fiscal consolidation.

cac3d02a1bf242.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 semiconductor and electronics measures?
o: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers equipment and raw materials
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 includes skill centres
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers indigenous IP and industry-led R&D
The electronics components manufacturing scheme allocation was raised to ₹30,000 crore
cac3d02a1bf242.x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore, not ₹30,000 crore.

cacd66cbb13473.s: Which of the following Union Budget 2026–27 proposals is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Related-entity data centre services – 15% safe harbour on costs
Component warehousing in bonded warehouses – 15% safe harbour on costs
Toll manufacturing in bonded zones – 5-year income-tax exemption for specified suppliers
Non-resident experts – Global income exempt for a 5-year stay under notified schemes
cacd66cbb13473.x: Component warehousing uses 2% of invoice value as the safe harbour margin; 15% on costs is for data centre services.

n7aa82761798.s: Union Budget 2026-27 raised the safe harbour threshold for IT services from ₹300 crore to:
n7aa82761798.x: The threshold was raised from ₹300 crore to ₹2,000 crore, with a 15.5% safe harbour margin.

n226e45e7f8e.s: Which two entities are to be restructured under Union Budget 2026-27?
n226e45e7f8e.x: The Budget proposed restructuring Power Finance Corporation and Rural Electrification Corporation.

ca05f96217ed90.s: After the 1950 Budget leak, Budget printing shifted from Rashtrapati Bhavan to:
ca05f96217ed90.x: Printing moved to Minto Road after the 1950 leak and to the North Block basement from 1980.

caa5f5236c58b3.s: Under Union Budget 2026–27, STT on options premium and exercise stands at:
caa5f5236c58b3.x: STT on options premium and exercise is 0.15%; STT on futures was raised to 0.05%.

ca0dd952806351.s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much over 5 years for CCUS technologies?
ca0dd952806351.x: The CCUS allocation is ₹20,000 crore over 5 years; the Budget also announced 7 high-speed rail corridors.

caf19b4b62e9a2.s: In which year did Nirmala Sitharaman replace the Budget briefcase with the Bahi-Khata?
caf19b4b62e9a2.x: The Bahi-Khata replaced the briefcase in 2019.

cad3d9fd1f4140.s: Who moved the Union Budget presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM?
cad3d9fd1f4140.x: Yashwant Sinha shifted the presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM.

n61809e7bbb8.s: Who was the first woman to present the Union Budget (1970-71)?
n61809e7bbb8.x: Indira Gandhi, while also Prime Minister, presented the 1970-71 Budget.

cae6137dd9fafb.s: Who presented the shortest Union Budget, of about 800 words, in 1977?
cae6137dd9fafb.x: H.M. Patel presented the shortest Budget in 1977, of about 800 words.

ca6a907827f8c3.s: Union Budget 2026–27 extends the deadline for revising an income-tax return from 31 December to:
ca6a907827f8c3.x: The revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March with a nominal fee.

cabc8b64d465fc.s: Under the textile expansion and employment scheme in Union Budget 2026–27, mega textile parks are proposed for:
cabc8b64d465fc.x: The scheme proposes mega textile parks for technical textiles; the National Fibre Scheme covers natural, synthetic and advanced fibres.

ca5010e40e81d8.s: The longest Union Budget speech by words (18,650 words) was delivered by:
ca5010e40e81d8.x: Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech was the longest by words; Sitharaman's 2020 speech was the longest by time (2 h 42 min).

ca7962d7efb61d.s: The Union Budget special scheme for legacy industrial clusters aims to rejuvenate how many clusters?
ca7962d7efb61d.x: The scheme is meant to rejuvenate 200 clusters, not 300.

ca93ff16047cec.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the divisible pool and the 16th Finance Commission?
o: Cesses and surcharges are subtracted from gross tax revenue to arrive at the divisible pool
The divisible pool's share of gross tax revenue has risen since 2014-15
The Commission did not raise the States' share, citing the Union's tight fiscal position
The cost of collection is also subtracted
ca93ff16047cec.x: The pool shrank from 89.1% of gross tax revenue in 2014-15 to about 74–80% during 2020-24.

ca8cff6527277f.x: Y.V. Reddy chaired the 14th FC; Kelkar the 13th, N.K. Singh the 15th and Panagariya the 16th.

ca029f34381e88.s: The 16th Finance Commission retained the States' share in the divisible pool of central taxes at:
ca029f34381e88.x: The States' share was retained at 41%; the 16th FC was chaired by Arvind Panagariya.

ca9ecfe19d7744.s: The new horizontal devolution parameter of the 16th Finance Commission addressed the population-control concern of which group of States?
ca9ecfe19d7744.x: Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Telangana were identified as gainers, addressing southern States' concern.

ca8efac2d5fa35.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and the Azad Hind Fauj?
o: Bharat Ratna was conferred on Bose posthumously in 1992
His Bharat Ratna, withdrawn in 1997, is the only such case
Rash Behari Bose handed over the INA to him on 4 July 1944
The Azad Hind Fauj was originally formed on 29 October 1915
ca8efac2d5fa35.x: The INA was handed over to Bose on 4 July 1943, not 1944.

caa8ae5ab9f93c.s: Which of the following about recent Telugu Sahitya Akademi winners is INCORRECTLY matched?
caa8ae5ab9f93c.x: Manodharmaparagam won in 2022 as a Novel, not as Poetry.

cab7888b8c927b.s:
Arrange the following Jnanpith Award recipients in chronological order:
1. Jagadguru Rambhadracharya
2. Nilmani Phookan
3. Akkitham Achuthan Namboothiri
cab7888b8c927b.x: Akkitham received the 55th award (2019), Phookan the 56th (2021) and Rambhadracharya the 58th (2023).

caf78abe3324bc.s: The Golden Globe Awards were first presented in:
caf78abe3324bc.x: They were first presented in 1944 by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association, founded in 1943.

caf45cce98cd4e.s: S.K.M. Mylananthan of Tamil Nadu received the Padma Bhushan 2026 in which field?
caf45cce98cd4e.x: S.K.M. Mylananthan was honoured in Social Work, not Medicine.

ca271bce5fe5f0.s: Which film won the Children's Film award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025?
ca271bce5fe5f0.x: Anaganaga won Children's Film; Thandel won National Integration and Little Hearts won Debut Feature.

caa2645378a793.s: Three of the five Padma Vibhushan 2026 awardees are from which State?
caa2645378a793.x: Three of the five awardees, including K.T. Thomas, are from Kerala.

ca6ed129ac54f7.s: Which film won the Environmental Film award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025?
ca6ed129ac54f7.x: Igwa won Environmental Film; Little Hearts won Debut Feature.

ca0d31ee501283.s: Prof. Shafi Shauq of Jammu & Kashmir received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
ca0d31ee501283.x: Prof. Shafi Shauq was honoured in Literature and Education.

ca02ecf349e6ff.s: In which year did Subhas Chandra Bose found the Forward Bloc?
ca02ecf349e6ff.x: Bose founded the Forward Bloc on 3 May 1939.

ca17b28bfc6e6f.s: Which film won the Children's & Family Film award at the 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026?
ca17b28bfc6e6f.x: Boong won Children's & Family Film; One Battle After Another was the biggest winner with six awards.

cacd3bafa0c670.s: Rajendra Prasad of Uttar Pradesh received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
cacd3bafa0c670.x: Rajendra Prasad was honoured in Medicine, not Science and Engineering.

cad2b418e0247a.s: Vempati Kutumba Sastry received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
cad2b418e0247a.x: Vempati Kutumba Sastry was awarded in Literature and Education; Deepika Reddy and Gadde Babu Rajendra Prasad were awarded in Arts.

ca961c6c12c856.s: What is the correct order of precedence of the Padma Awards (highest first)?
o: Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Shri
Padma Vibhushan, Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan
Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan
Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri
ca961c6c12c856.x: The order is Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri; the awards carry no cash prize.

ca5bfdc6a1f87a.s: The Jnanpith Award includes a bronze statue of:
ca5bfdc6a1f87a.x: The Jnanpith Award, given by Bharatiya Jnanpith, includes a bronze statue of Vagdevi (Saraswati).

ca5fa3281d7268.s: Who won Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Hamnet?
ca5fa3281d7268.x: Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet; Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.

caed04f60e3a59.s: How many posthumous awardees were there in the Padma Awards 2026?
caed04f60e3a59.x: There were 16 posthumous awardees and 6 foreign awardees.

ca3788cd706fe0.s: K. Pazhanivel of Puducherry received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
ca3788cd706fe0.x: K. Pazhanivel was honoured in Sports.

ca33d41d3fb241.s: Of the 24 books covered by the Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025, how many were poetry books?
ca33d41d3fb241.x: The distribution was 8 poetry, 6 short-story, 4 novels, 2 essays, 2 memoirs, 1 criticism and 1 autobiography.

ca859ca6b1512a.s: The Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar was first conferred in:
ca859ca6b1512a.x: It was first conferred in 2019 by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

cac7562f71c372.s: Padma Bhushan 2026 awardee Shibu Soren was associated with which State?
cac7562f71c372.x: Shibu Soren was associated with Jharkhand; V.K. Malhotra was the Delhi awardee.

ca1413530443e1.s: The Azad Hind Government was established on 21 October 1943 at:
ca1413530443e1.x: It was established at Singapore; the Tricolour was hoisted at Port Blair later, on 30 December 1943.

ca0f0c690e8217.s: Who won Best Director at the 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026, his first BAFTA in that category?
ca0f0c690e8217.x: Paul Thomas Anderson won the Director category, his first BAFTA for Best Director.

cac1e3a6dc9448.s: A posthumous Padma Award may be given only if the death occurred within:
cac1e3a6dc9448.x: Posthumous awards are normally not given, but may be allowed if death occurred within one year.

caeaca79524122.x: The award comprised a casket with an engraved copper plaque, a shawl and ₹1,00,000.

ca836fac60cec7.s: Sahiti won the Female Singer award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025 for which film?
ca836fac60cec7.x: Sahiti won for Kannappa; Anurag Kulkarni won Male Singer for Raju Weds Rambayi.

cac3773d89edc9.s: In which year was the name 'Oscar' adopted for the Academy Awards?
cac3773d89edc9.x: The name 'Oscar' was adopted in 1939, not 1949.
